enchantments.tooltip: Quality Enchantment Focus +2: +2 Quality bonus to the DC of Enchantment spells.
Wizardry +269: +269 Enhancement bonus to spell points.
Lesser Displacement: Equipping this item causes light to distort around you. Attacks from enemies have a 25% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Stealth Strike: Reduces the threat generated by ranged attacks and spells by 15%.
Mythic Neck Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
